description: CATALYSTS, WORKERS & CONNECTED MCPs — for flows that reach past mojulo: curated workflow recipes (get / list / recommend catalysts, mint a custom one) that land as a Skill on this host beside its other MCPs (get / list adapters), what those MCPs can do (declare the inventory, record / read a provider's capabilities), and the agent-task queue an outside worker drains (pull_agent_task → submit_envelope_inference → cancel). Open for 'is there a recipe for X', 'install this workflow as a skill', 'send this mesh to my Blender MCP', 'work the task queue'.
